            htmlElement.classList.remove('modal-opened');
        }

            }

        document.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  const form = e.target;

  if (form.id !== 'emailSubscribeForm') return;

  e.preventDefault();

  const card = form.closest('.newsletter-card');
  if (!card) return;

  const input = card.querySelector('#emailInput');
  const messageBox = card.querySelector('#emailSubscribeMessage');

  const email = input?.value?.trim();
  if (!email) return;

  setMessage(messageBox, 'Submitting...', 'loading');

  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      email,
      station: window.STATION_ROC_ID,
      stationType: form?.dataset?.stationType || '',
    });

    const res = await fetch(`/r/kappa/api/v2/reader/email_subscribe?${params.toString()}`, {
      method: 'GET',
    });

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Subscription failed');

    const msg = data.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'success' ? 'Subscribed successfully!' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'success');

    form.reset();
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err?.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'error' ? 'Something went wrong...' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'error');
  }
});

function setMessage(el, text, type) {
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'newsletter-message ' + type;
}

const bodyElement = document.body;
    const htmlElement = document.documentElement;

    // Function to update the HTML class based on the body class
    function updateHtmlClass() {
        if (bodyElement.className.includes('-opened')) {
            htmlElement.classList.add('modal-opened');
        } else {
            htmlElement.classList.remove('modal-opened');
        }
    }

    // Create a MutationObserver to monitor changes in class attribute of the body
    const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        mutations.forEach(mutation => {
            
            if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                updateHtmlClass();
            }
        });
    });

    // Start observing the body for attribute changes
    observer.observe(bodyElement, {
        attributes: true //configure it to listen to attribute changes
    });

    // Initial check in case the class is already set when the script runs
    updateHtmlClass();

        document.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  const form = e.target;

  if (form.id !== 'emailSubscribeForm') return;

  e.preventDefault();

  const card = form.closest('.newsletter-card');
  if (!card) return;

  const input = card.querySelector('#emailInput');
  const messageBox = card.querySelector('#emailSubscribeMessage');

  const email = input?.value?.trim();
  if (!email) return;

  setMessage(messageBox, 'Submitting...', 'loading');

  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      email,
      station: window.STATION_ROC_ID,
      stationType: form?.dataset?.stationType || '',
    });

    const res = await fetch(`/r/kappa/api/v2/reader/email_subscribe?${params.toString()}`, {
      method: 'GET',
    });

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Subscription failed');

    const msg = data.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'success' ? 'Subscribed successfully!' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'success');

    form.reset();
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err?.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'error' ? 'Something went wrong...' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'error');
  }
});

function setMessage(el, text, type) {
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'newsletter-message ' + type;
}

            htmlElement.classList.remove('modal-opened');
        }

        document.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  const form = e.target;

  if (form.id !== 'emailSubscribeForm') return;

  e.preventDefault();

  const card = form.closest('.newsletter-card');
  if (!card) return;

  const input = card.querySelector('#emailInput');
  const messageBox = card.querySelector('#emailSubscribeMessage');

  const email = input?.value?.trim();
  if (!email) return;

  setMessage(messageBox, 'Submitting...', 'loading');

  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      email,
      station: window.STATION_ROC_ID,
      stationType: form?.dataset?.stationType || '',
    });

    const res = await fetch(`/r/kappa/api/v2/reader/email_subscribe?${params.toString()}`, {
      method: 'GET',
    });

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Subscription failed');

    const msg = data.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'success' ? 'Subscribed successfully!' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'success');

    form.reset();
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err?.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'error' ? 'Something went wrong...' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'error');
  }
});

function setMessage(el, text, type) {
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'newsletter-message ' + type;
}

const bodyElement = document.body;
    const htmlElement = document.documentElement;

    // Function to update the HTML class based on the body class
    function updateHtmlClass() {
        if (bodyElement.className.includes('-opened')) {
            htmlElement.classList.add('modal-opened');
        } else {
            htmlElement.classList.remove('modal-opened');
        }
    }

    // Create a MutationObserver to monitor changes in class attribute of the body
    const observer = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
        mutations.forEach(mutation => {
            
            if (mutation.type === 'attributes' && mutation.attributeName === 'class') {
                updateHtmlClass();
            }
        });
    });

    // Start observing the body for attribute changes
    observer.observe(bodyElement, {
        attributes: true //configure it to listen to attribute changes
    });

    // Initial check in case the class is already set when the script runs
    updateHtmlClass();

window.REBELMOUSE_ACTIVE_TASKS_QUEUE.push(function(){

    
        document.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
  const form = e.target;

  if (form.id !== 'emailSubscribeForm') return;

  e.preventDefault();

  const card = form.closest('.newsletter-card');
  if (!card) return;

  const input = card.querySelector('#emailInput');
  const messageBox = card.querySelector('#emailSubscribeMessage');

  const email = input?.value?.trim();
  if (!email) return;

  setMessage(messageBox, 'Submitting...', 'loading');

  try {
    const params = new URLSearchParams({
      email,
      station: window.STATION_ROC_ID,
      stationType: form?.dataset?.stationType || '',
    });

    const res = await fetch(`/r/kappa/api/v2/reader/email_subscribe?${params.toString()}`, {
      method: 'GET',
    });

    const data = await res.json();
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error(data.message || 'Subscription failed');

    const msg = data.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'success' ? 'Subscribed successfully!' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'success');

    form.reset();
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err?.message;
    const display = !msg || msg.toLowerCase() === 'error' ? 'Something went wrong...' : msg;

    setMessage(messageBox, display, 'error');
  }
});

function setMessage(el, text, type) {
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = text;
  el.className = 'newsletter-message ' + type;
}
